products.name: Altered
products.note: Professional voice editing; voice morphing; dubbing; consent management; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Altered is a UK-hosted AI voice technology company operating under the brand Altered Studio. The company describes itself as offering professional AI voice changer software and services, with its core product being Altered Studio, a voice content creation platform that combines Speech-To-Speech voice morphing with a range of voice AI tools in a single application aimed at media production. The platform includes a voice editor for working within existing audio and video files, support for traditional DSP effects alongside AI tools, and a RealTime Pro Voice Changer designed for use in voice and video calls.

The held facts note that the product suite also covers dubbing and consent management features, and that the service is UK-hosted. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
